OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_CARDPILE_EXCLUSION_: Cards are placed here when they are [gold]excluded[/gold]; they cannot be recovered by normal means.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_CARDPILE_OMNITRIX_S: Cards you had before transforming are kept here, and shuffled into your draw pile once the transformation ends.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_PLANT_GROWTH.title: Plant Growth {Hp}
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_PLANT_GROWTH.descri: Give your plants on the field [blue]{Hp}[/blue] Max HP and heal them for the same amount.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ALIEN_SCORCH.title: Scorch
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ALIEN_SCORCH.descri:
At the end of this enemy's turn, it takes damage equal to [blue]{DamagePerStack}[/blue] times its [gold]Scorch[/gold], then loses ALL Scorch.
This damage can be blocked.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ALIEN_BURN_STATUS.d:
Unplayable. At the end of your turn, take [blue]2[/blue] damage if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Heatblast exhausts ALL Status cards in your Hand before this resolves. Whenever Heatblast exhausts a Burn, heal [blue]2[/blue] HP.
Energy gained from cards, relics or powers.
The normal turn-start Energy reset does not count.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ALIEN_FOUR_ARM_STRE: Gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] on transformation. Every [blue]4[/blue] Attack cards played, double your current Strength.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ALIEN_PREY.title: Prey
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ALIEN_PREY.descript:
The enemy marked by [gold]Wild Pursuit[/gold].
When the current Prey dies, mark the surviving enemy with the lowest current HP.
On transformation, mark the lowest-current-HP enemy as [gold]Prey[/gold].
Each Attack card that hits Prey deals one extra attack with [blue]6[/blue] base damage.
When Prey dies, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]1[/blue] card, then mark new Prey.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ALIEN_FEAR.title: Fear
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ALIEN_FEAR.descript:
Normal and Elite enemies become [gold]Soul Frightened[/gold] at [blue]{SoulFrightThreshold}[/blue] Fear; primary enemies in Boss rooms require [blue]{BossSoulFrightThreshold}[/blue].
Normal and Elite enemies become [gold]Dispersed[/gold] at [blue]{DisperseThreshold}[/blue] Fear; primary enemies in Boss rooms require [blue]{BossDisperseThreshold}[/blue].
Fear does not decay.
At the end of the next player turn after Ghostfreak ends, remove ALL Fear and its Soul Fright/Disperse effects.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ALIEN_SOUL_FRIGHT.d:
Gained at [blue]{SoulFrightThreshold}[/blue] [gold]Fear[/gold].
Only Block intents work. Attacks, summons, debuffs, buffs, healing and all other intents are disabled.
Removed with Fear at the end of the next player turn after Ghostfreak ends.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_ALIEN_DISPERSE.desc:
Gained at [blue]{DisperseThreshold}[/blue] [gold]Fear[/gold].
The enemy dies on its next action.
Removed with Fear at the end of the next player turn after Ghostfreak ends.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_TEMPORARY_HEALTH.de:
Extra HP that absorbs damage after Block and pays HP-loss costs before normal HP.
Any remaining loss is paid with normal HP. Healing cannot restore it. Does not change Max HP. At combat end, consume the remaining Absorption to heal that much HP.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_APPLE_RESISTANCE.de: Take [blue]20%[/blue] less damage this combat. Does not reduce HP-loss costs.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_APPLE_FIRE_RESISTAN: Immune to damage from [gold]Burn[/gold] Status cards this combat.
